title: The erase ordering has a Swift copy on the iPhone: RecordStore.Mark.holds and EraseGate (same meaning, Swift copy of the web erase machine's epoch order)
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore+Mark.swift:16 holds(at:) compares epoch, erasures and the cloud erase; ios/HealthRoadmap/Health/HealthSyncMemory.swift:216 EraseGate.decide disconnects Apple Health on a higher epoch. The identity's format and epoch order are health-core's (erase-identity.ts:17 eraseIdentityOf, merge.ts); the web machine is widget-src/src/lib/erase-machine.ts. No shared code: the phone's screen state is Swift and cannot call the transition (fix 4 design Q4)
